source.title: Blizzard Armory: Nesterin, paired Miststalker's Spaulders and Wristbands equipped at item level 305
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

notes: New cross-item version context, NOT a disenchant study: Blizzard's Armory shows the same character wearing Miststalker's Spaulders (272244) at item level 305 and Miststalker's Wristbands (272246) at item level 305. Another Armory character (Shriko) has both at item level 308. Wowhead exposes 272244 at item levels 206, 282 (rare), 295 and 321 (epic), and lists a Disenchanting (5) section, but no controlled level-specific operation log or source-row hit counts were recovered. WowDB's item 272246 static build 68209, ilvl 206 says Cannot be disenchanted. This does NOT establish eligibility for 272244 or 272246 at 305, and must not create a blanket disenchant veto or a modeled drop chance. Wowhead Looter aggregate version cannot be assigned to the equipped Armory items. The previous 272246 search audit and Cowl/Cuisses cohorts remain distinct; no cohorts were duplicated. Master should prioritize an in-game 305 bracer/shoulder eligibility check and record exact item link, item level, build, skill and spec before a valuation rule.
lookingFor: Paired Miststalker's Spaulders 272244 and Wristbands 272246 actual item-level-305 disenchant eligibility and original completed-cast outcomes by build, profession skill and specialization
